newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto 300 index ends at new high for second day.
newsitem.headline: Toronto 300 index ends at new high for second day.

text.p: Toronto's key 300 Index finished at record highs for a second straight session on Tuesday, but the overall market was mixed as institutional investors juggled portfolios ahead of month end.
The TSE 300 Composite Index edged up 2.62 points to close at 5268.48, beating the previous record close set on Monday.
The index also set a new intraday peak of 5273.92.
But the overall market ended mixed. Declining stocks outnumbered advances 468 to 421, with 326 issues unchanged.
Trading was very heavy as 90.4 million shares exchanged hands for a total value of C$1.22 billion (US$890 million).

"Institutional investors are dressing up their portfolios ahead of the September month end," said John Ing, president of Maison Placements Canada Inc, noting gains in the banking and base metal groups.
Takeover action and optimism about small and mid-tier gold companies also contributed to the TSE's modest rise.

But renewed interest rate fears also weighed on Canada's biggest stock market. Bonds ended sharply weaker after a senior Fed official said there is a growing consensus among Fed policymakers that U.S. rates will rise 25 basis points.
* Loewen Group Inc soared 8.45 to close at 54.95 on news of a US$4.1 billion takeover bid from rival funeral home operator Service Corp. Loewen earlier hit a new high of 57.
* Goldstake Explorations Inc. led heavy traders, jumping 2.37 to 3.55 on 6.5 million shares after releasing encouraging assay results from its Soreang concession in Java.
* Other junior gold miners climbed as well. Bre-X Minerals Ltd. climbed 1.15 to 27.15 on 1.4 million shares. Bema Gold Corp gained 0.15 to 10.80 on 1.3 million shares.
* Among weak stocks, transport giant Bombardier Inc. class B fell 0.75 to 18 on 1.5 million shares.
